defects.issue: Advisory, non-blocking, and NOT a defect in the prose as written. 'The Labels chip always shows a count' is true, but the number a user sees may not equal the number of labels they checked. The chip counts raw ids (`count: filters.labels.length`, board-toolbar.tsx:638-640) while the menu lists labels grouped by name+color (`uniqueLabels`, 184-193) and `toggleLabelGroup` (233-247) selects EVERY workspace label row sharing that name+color. Because get-labels-by-workspace-id.ts returns all rows in `labelTable` for the workspace (including per-task label rows, which task-labels-popover.tsx:86 filters with `taskId === null`), checking one label named 'bug' that is applied to six tasks can render 'Labels include any of 7 selected'. The doc never claims the count equals a number of labels, and its own remedy ('open the filter menu to see which labels are applied') is exactly the right mitigation, so no wording change is required.
defects.fix: No doc change requested. Root cause is the id-vs-group counting mismatch in apps/web/src/components/board/board-toolbar.tsx (untouched by this run) — out of scope for a docs-intent brownfield run per the changed-files rule. Recommend the orchestrator log this as a separate UI backlog item (chip should count selected label groups, not label rows) rather than dispatching a docs refinement that would either restate the bug or leak implementation detail into user-facing prose.
